headline: Claude for DTC Media Buying: the 10 levels
subhead: A free course in 10 levels, from one saved prompt to a complete system that keeps your ads testing and scaling. Prompts, project and skill templates, agent briefs and a 30-day plan.
subhead_secondary: Every prompt, skill and agent uses only what you paste, shows its arithmetic, and names the exact input it is missing when something is not there.
inside: 10 lessons, from The Saved Prompt to The Complete System
Copy-and-paste prompts for every stage, from customer research to performance reporting
Project, skill and agent templates, with guardrails, ready to fill in
A real media buying workflow in every level
proof: Built by the team that runs paid growth for DTC brands. RISE buys media for DTC brands and gets paid on the growth it adds. We used this same process on a brand that cut ad spend 40% and more than tripled profit in six months.
